# T-1: Add submodule cleanup guard

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Add submodule-specific worktree remove handling inside finalize-cleanup teardown while preserving existing non-submodule behavior.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Normal remove remains the first attempt.
- Submodule-related normal remove failure triggers clean-state inspection.
- Clean submodule worktrees retry with `git worktree remove --force <path>` once.
- Dirty, status-failed, or force-remove-failed worktrees halt without deleting the worktree or branch.
- Halt envelopes expose dedicated submodule cleanup error codes and bounded diagnostic data.
- Existing successful teardown side effects remain intact.

## Implementation Notes
Keep the change local to finalize-cleanup teardown helpers. Use existing git command logging path. Bound diagnostic lists returned in envelopes.

## Test Strategy
Use unit tests with real temporary git repositories and submodule fixtures or controlled git-command seams to verify success and halt paths.
